paragraphs.text: The Marvel's Spider-Man Welcome Decks are five monocolored thirty-card ready-to-play sample decks . They were released together with the main set on September 26, 2025.

The Welcome decks consist of basic lands , commons , 4 uncommons , 1 rare and 1 mythic rare . They are provided for free to newcomers in a pack that contains two of these decks and instructions. The majority of cards have the Marvel's Spider-Man set code (SPM) and expansion symbol ( ) but the set also includes 20 cards from the eternal-legal Spider-Man Eternal subset (5 commons, 5 uncommons, 5 rares, 5 mythic rares) . Each is marked with the corresponding set code (SPE) and expansion symbol ( ).
The Welcome Decks cards with the SPM set code are Standard -legal once Marvel's Spider-Man is released. Those with the SPE set code are only legal in eternal formats.

These 30-card decks can be provided by an LGS to new players during Open House events or for walk-in demos. There are two decks in each box; one in an indicated color, and the other a random one of the five mana colors in Magic . After the demo experience, the new player can take home their deck free-of-charge to continue their Magic journey. Designed as a tool for new player acquisition, the decks also include a peek at some Booster Fun cards (with 2 Booster Fun cards in each deck), plus a way to play against a friend or mentor until they get the hang of the rules.

Similar to Jumpstart packs , a player can pick any two Welcome Decks, shuffle them together, and instantly have a 60-card deck to play with. Players are encouraged to use the mix-and-match gameplay as a mechanically simple way to demonstrate color combinations and variety in deck strategy.
The expansion code used by Wizards of the Coast for these decks is WD4.
The rare in this deck is Amazing Alliance and the mythic rare is Spider-Man, Peter Parker .
The rare in this deck is Future Flight and the mythic rare is Spider-Man 2099, Miguel O'Hara .
The rare in this deck is Lethal Protection and the mythic rare is Venom, Eddie Brock .
The rare in this deck is Double Trouble and the mythic rare is Ghost-Spider, Gwen Stacy .
The rare in this deck is Venom Blast and the mythic rare is Spider-Man, Miles Morales .
These have the set code SPE, and are not Standard -legal.
